examples.title: Example 1: Drawing Shapes
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to draw shapes using APIs in DrawingRenderingContext.

examples.title: Example 2: Drawing Text
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to draw custom text using drawTextBlob, with custom fonts loaded via makeFromRawFile (available since API version 18). When the drawing API is used, custom fonts from the rawfile directory can be loaded directly with drawing.Typeface.makeFromRawFile, eliminating the need to pre-register fonts through this.uiContext.getFont().registerFont or fontCollection.loadFontSync.
